creator: Alexander Terp
description: ./dev --linux runs muster-daemon's and muster-detect's suites on Linux in a Debian container (dash as /bin/sh), natively on arm64 and under emulation for x86_64. It is not in CI: macOS runners have no docker, so it needs a Linux runner that can run ./dev's deps step (Rust, Zig, the patched libghostty build), or a split job that builds on macOS and tests on Linux. Until then a Linux regression is caught only when someone runs the tier or --ssh by hand.
title: Run ./dev --linux in CI
